rubric_content.text_property: The response is a valid JSON object containing weather_summary, sun_phase, tides, pilot_notes, and facilities.

When a next destination is provided in the prompt, pilot_notes includes a 'departure_and_arrival_timing' object (or equivalent timing guidance) addressing the recommended departure window, departure tide constraints, arrival daylight margin vs sunset, and any night-entry / unlit-aid warnings.
The agent calls 'GetWeather' with the latitude and longitude mentioned in the user prompt.
The agent calls 'GetTides' with the date mentioned in the user prompt.

The agent delegates facility discovery by calling the 'facility_discovery' tool/sub-agent, passing the search radius (in nautical miles or miles) from the user prompt. (The facility_discovery sub-agent performs the underlying find_places_nearby calls and radius-to-meters conversion internally.)
